scope: Corollary 7.6 (Widths at the support scale) of the manuscript “Witnessed symmetric choice is strictly stronger than choiceless polynomial time with counting” (preprints/Witnessed-symmetric-choice-is-strictly-stronger-than-choiceless-polynomial-time-with-counting-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 243 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d648a0d83b5f41b1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 32. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix positive integers q, m independently of L, and let N = NL = Θ(L3 ), s = l 2L(q log3 N + 1)2 m + 1, M = ⌊L7/4 ⌋. For all sufficiently large L, Proposition 7.3 holds, Proposition 7.5 applies to every tuple length 1 ≤ r ≤ (m + 4)s in either expansion, and max{4, m + 1}s ≤ M. In particular, both expansions are K-homogeneous for equal CM types of tuples of length at most max{2, m}s.
